name: Temple The Second
overview: The Second Temple was built on the site of the first temple, fulfilling the prophecy of Jeremiah as evidenced by King Cyrus's decree to rebuild God's house in Jerusalem (Ezra 1:1-3). Cyrus not only authorized the Jews to return and rebuild but also provided resources and returned the sacred vessels taken by Nebuchadnezzar (Ezra 1:4, 7-8). This act of divine sovereignty and provision underscores God's faithfulness in restoring worship and the central place of the temple in Israel's spiritual life.
